items.title: Etale cohomology of a directed limit of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes is the colimit of the cohomologies
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the etale cohomology of a directed limit of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes over S with the colimit of the cohomologies of the approximants, for coefficients in a bounded below object of D^+(S_etale) (statement lines 7852-7863). The reduction is explicit but requires choosing the right representative: one replaces K by a bounded below complex G^bullet with G^n = 0 for n < a, pulls it back to X_i and to X, and observes that the pullback to the limit is the termwise colimit of the F_i^bullet along the transition maps (proof lines 7866-7872). The statement then becomes the same-chapter variant lemma on colimits of complexes, which the author invokes (proof line 7873). The claim is H2: one reduction to a concrete complex plus one colimit identification, with the bounded-below hypothesis used to make the representative exist.
